answer: Prayers & Duties >> Jumuah & Eid Prayers Question ID: 45529 Country: United States of America Title: Jumuah salah Question: Is it permissible to have 2 Jumuah salah in one masjid? I live in America and due to lack of space we have 2 Jumuah in our masjid. So far according to all our books I know the ruling is that if one misses his Jumuah salah then he should pray his Zuhr salah. So what about you come to the masjid but due to lack of space you could not pray so what should one do now? Answer ID: 45529 Posted on: Aug 27, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 855/539/L=1434) It is makrooh to manage two Jumuah salah in one mosque. Hence two Jumuah jamah should not be done in one mosque. However, if some people miss Jumuah salah then you may offer Jumuah salah with jamah out of the mosque in some other place and not in the mosque. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
